column1: # Batch 9: the 84 names that exist only on /tools/funny-boat-names/ (the other
# 26 on that page are already tagged through their generator category).
# THIS IS WHERE LEVEL x LIVES. Everything before this batch graded out c or d;
# the funny page is the only part of the bank carrying genuine innuendo, and
# the page says so itself ("order at your own risk"). Nine names are x. Where a
# reading is ambiguous I have graded UP, not down - a gate that wrongly keeps a
# clean name away from a family boat costs one name; a gate that wrongly deals
# a crude one costs the customer his transom and the shop the job.
# ALSO NOTE: Vitamin Sea and Seas the Day are here. The spec names both as the
# Tier-1 overuse class by example - they are the two most common boat names in
# America. Mechanism tagging does not exclude them; the overuse gate will, and
# these two rows are its first test case.

column4: graded up - it reads crude out loud, and that is the version a stranger hears
